_note: Source folder -> product page slug, for the libraries that have no families.json.
Boilers, water heaters and Vortice are mapped by reusing tools/<those>/families.json,
so only the air-conditioner library needs a table here.
'dir' is matched with StartsWith against the path below the category folder, the same
way the image scripts resolve their source folders. 'slugs' lists every page the
documents in that folder belong to -- an indoor/outdoor pair shares one folder.
_pins: Folders that two families.json entries both list in imgdirs, pinned to the one page
their documents go to. An entry here beats a families.json entry for the same folder;
1-inventory.ps1 warns about any shared folder not pinned here.
Each pin keeps the page the documents were first published on (2026-09-03). Two of
them hold more than their name says: LINEO_Q also contains the plain LINEO models
(17143-17149), and MFO_ contains MF 1506 T HCS LL (11176), so those documents sit on
the LINEO QUIET and MFO pages. Splitting them by article code is a separate change.
_skipped: range brochures covering the whole residential / commercial line. They belong on the
Vortice brand page rather than on any one model, and brand pages have no documents
panel -- mapping them anywhere else would either orphan the file or repeat an 8.5 MB
